title: SessionWrite
description: The body of POST /v1/sessions and PATCH /v1/sessions/{session_id}. One field, because a session's label is the only thing about a session a caller supplies — everything else on the resource is either minted by the server or aggregated from the session's own runs and meters.

name.description: The display label. ABSENT and EMPTY are different values here, which is why the type admits null: absent (or null) means the caller is not setting a label — on create the session simply has none and its projection derives one from the first prompt, and on PATCH it is a 400, because a rename that renames nothing is a request that lost its field. An empty string is a real value that CLEARS the operator label and returns the row to the derived one.
